assumptions: Design choice: issue option 2 (one synthetic failed row per file that failed outside any test). It is the only option the approved reproducing test (`run.failed > 0`) admits without a schema change: option 1 (refuse) throws instead of counting, and option 3 (run-level field) cannot pass validateBuiltRun, which requires total == rows and the status counts to sum to total.

The synthetic row is named `<file> (file failed outside any test)`, not a shared constant: flake/timeline queries key on test_name alone, so a shared name would merge every file's load failures into one history. test_file is the file and error_text is vitest's file `message`.

Trigger is `status === 'failed'` AND a non-empty file `message`. vitest leaves the file message empty when only assertions failed, so an ordinary test failure is not double counted (covered by a test).
A report where EVERY file fails to load still abstains as an empty report (countVitestResults unchanged); that is pre-existing behavior and out of scope.
